newsitem.title: USA: Ultrak files for 2.6 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Ultrak files for 2.6 mln shr offering.

text.p: Ultrak Inc said on Monday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 2.6 million shares of its common stock.
The company said in a statement it would sell 2,507,540 of the shares and 92,460 shares would be sold by a warrant holder. No shares will be sold in the offering by a company officer or director.
The company also plans to grant underwriters an over-allotment option to buy up to 390,000 additional shares of common stock.
J.C. Bradford & Co and Hoak Breedlove Wesneski & Co will co-manage the offering. The company, a marketer of security alarm systems, has about 10.3 million shares outstanding.
